cs.t: It's a pity. I still use my 12 year old Withings scale, and it works like a charm. Also have been using the Withings watch and Withings blood pressure monitor. Withings builds long lasting products that just work. However, even if the sync for me as existing customer still works, I don't support paywalling basic functionality. Thus, for my future purchases I will choose a different brand. That's imho the only language companies understand: Lost revenue. It was nice as long as it lasted.
cs.th: New Withings Users Must Pay $99/Year for Apple Health Syncing

cs.t: Well, crap. I really like Withings's scales. They're very nice and the results closely match medical equipment readings I've had, so in my experience they've been great for keeping track of things between checkups. Their privacy policy is (or at least was) one of the only ones I'd trust with medical data. The iOS app started to get annoying with its extra subscription features, which I couldn't care less about because I get them through other means. But subscribing so that the scale in my bathroom, which syncs to the app in my phone, can sync to another app on that same phone? LOL, hell no. That simply will not happen. And even though it only applies to new users now, if there's not enough pushback that it loses them more business than it gains them, my official prediction is that within a year it'll cover  new accounts, or new devices added to existing accounts .
cs.th: New Withings Users Must Pay $99/Year for Apple Health Syncing
